discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in c8bd341b8. I reproduced this: with `diff.external` set, `git diff` ran the program and `git diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv` did not. `core.fsmonitor` also runs a program from `git status` and from `git diff --no-ext-diff`, though, so no flag makes Git safe in a repository you don't trust. The example now drops `git diff`, and its comment says to approve Git commands only in repositories you trust.
